newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate eases, baht down late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate eases, baht down late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was down to 9.50-10.00 percent in late trade on Wednesday from 10.50 percent early on rising market liquidity, dealers said.
"Most banks and even finance companies appeared to have a lot of excess funds today. The selling of the dollar also boosted the liquidity," said one dealer at a European bank.
The baht was lower at 25.679-25.682 to the dollar late from 25.670-25.680 early on late dollar buying, dealers said.
"There was very heavy selling of the dollar in the morning. But some late dollar buying pushed the U.S. currency slightly higher," another dealer said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar mid-rate at 25.69 against 25.66 on Tuesday.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 8.50/9.00 satangs per dollar late compared with 8.00/8.50 earlier.
